name: agentmemory-agents
title_zh: 只认官方适配器，装错路径当场报错的内存接线员
tagline_zh: 装 agentmemory 到宿主编码 agent 时，它替你核对 connect 命令该写哪个配置路径。
tagline_en: When wiring agentmemory into a host coding agent, it double-checks which config path the connect command should.
desc_en: How agentmemory wires into host coding agents via the connect command. Use when installing agentmemory into a specific agent, when asked which agents are supported, or when a connect adapter writes the wrong config path.
why_zh: 机制上它不猜：每个 connect 适配器都带白名单路径校验，写错位置直接停下告诉你。
why_en: It never guesses: every connect adapter ships with whitelisted path validation, halting on mismatch instead of silently writing.
limit_zh: 只管 agentmemory 的 connect 接线，不覆盖记忆检索、存储或向量化逻辑。只认官方列出的宿主 agen。
limit_en: Only handles agentmemory's connect wiring; no retrieval/storage/vector logic. Supports only officially listed host agents; custom agents need your.
title_en: Memory wiring that rejects wrong adapter paths
unshelf_reason: 2026-09-04 编辑判：记忆引擎的配置/接线/拆解三件，英文开发工具链（冷在读者身上）
